newsitem.title: CANADA: Air Canada regional pilots talks fail - union.
newsitem.headline: Air Canada regional pilots talks fail - union.

text.p: The Canadian Air Line Pilots Association, The union representing Air Canada's regional pilots, said on Thursday talks last night between it, Air Canada and Air Canada Regional Airline management, and the Air Canada Pilots Association, made no progress.
The talks were monitored by representatives of the Federal Mediation and Conciliation Service.
"Despite thorough dialogue, no progress was made on any of the issues before the parties, including fair access to work," the union said.
The six-day-old strike will continue, it added.
No further meetings are planned at this time. The regional pilots are striking against Air Canada's four subsidiaries - Air Nova, Air Alliance, Air BC and Air Ontario.
